gloss: summer resort; retreat from the heat

definitions.gloss: summer resort; retreat from the heat
definitions.explanation: A place, typically in the mountains or at higher elevations, where people go to escape the summer heat. These areas are naturally cooler than cities.

examples.japanese: {軽井沢|かるいざわ}は{有名|ゆうめい}な{避暑地|ひしょち}だ。
examples.english: Karuizawa is a famous summer resort.

examples.japanese: {毎年|まいとし}{夏|なつ}になると{避暑地|ひしょち}に{出|で}かける{家族|かぞく}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Every summer, many families head to summer resorts.

examples.japanese: {都会|とかい}の{猛暑|もうしょ}を{避|さ}けて、{涼|すず}しい{高原|こうげん}の{避暑地|ひしょち}で{一週間|いっしゅうかん}ほど{過|す}ごした。
examples.english: Escaping the intense heat of the city, I spent about a week at a cool highland summer resort.

notes:
CULTURE:
Famous Japanese summer resorts include {軽井沢|かるいざわ} (Karuizawa), {那須|なす} (Nasu), and {箱根|はこね} (Hakone). The concept became popular during the Meiji era when foreign residents and Japanese elite began retreating to the mountains in summer. These areas typically feature cooler temperatures, forests, and a relaxed atmosphere.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {避暑地|ひしょち}に{行|い}く (to go to a summer resort)
- {避暑地|ひしょち}として{知|し}られる (to be known as a summer resort)
- {人気|にんき}の{避暑地|ひしょち} (a popular summer resort)
